members.note: The multi-line boxed field is UDreamTextInput with bMultiLine ticked -- one axis of UMG's four classes is a property here. FString; see EditableTextBox.json.
One FDreamTextInputStyle for both line modes; the line count changes the field's height, not its look.
No Blueprint accessor; FVirtualKeyboardOptions has no BlueprintType, exactly as in UMG.
In multi-line mode the commit moment is Enter with one of MultiLineSubmitFunctionKeys held, which is the library's answer to 'Enter makes a line, so what submits'.

UMG's FTextBlockStyle half of the box's look. Colour and size are FDreamTextInputStyle's; the outline/shadow/glow half is UDreamText::TextStyle (FDreamTextStyle) and the control does not forward it yet -- see EditableText.json GetFont for where the typeface and the effects each live.
Appearance lives in the style struct; it moves through SetStyle or the project sheet.
